resolution.rationale: Upstream v0.97.0 does not change endsTurnsWithLiveSubagents, turnAwaitingSubagents or the backgroundSubagents capability that this patch extends to clients opting into settleAtResult, so the patch is not absorbed and its gate still covers every caller, for ACP v1 only. The v0.97.0 src/acp-agent.ts edits add the ultracode session config option (#1438), let a result that names only a steer's uuid answer the live turn that owns the steer (#1185), route advisor_tool_result through the tool result path (#1247), keep a foreground fork's placeholder launch result out of its own transcript (#1431), keep the usage-limit error when it arrives after compaction (#1377) and pass --settings before the auth status subcommand (#1392). #1185 lets a result that names only a steer's uuid answer the live turn that owns the steer when Claude Code folds the steer into an autonomous cycle, and skips a turn held open for its subagents (isHeldOpen). No turn of a settleAtResult client is held, so such a client gets the same answer as an AIR client with backgroundSubagents. The patch adds its opt-in next to the context usage opt-in, so it is stacked on the adapted context usage and async task patches. The sync replays original downstream commits before adaptation commits, so an original commit stacked on an adapted patch conflicts and must be adapted too. 6a528efc8f3d208968a72224808fde741027e926 reapplies the unchanged added and removed lines of a90195ee378736d7da5540fbbb1f72f9af6688a2 and adds one test for the #1185 path: a settleAtResult client steers a turn that started a background subagent, the steer is folded into a task-notification cycle, session/prompt resolves at that cycle's result while the subagent still runs, and the subagent's follow-up reaches the client afterwards. The test fails with the original gate, where the turn is held for the subagent, and with #1185's source change reverted. It gives the replacement a stable patch-id (af998ad4) distinct from every retired ledger commit.
